claims.title: Preserve failed numerical shared-mode allocations without promoting them to a no-go theorem

quoted_fields.interface: The new ongoing Ultra turn explores combining two local triad corrections while allocating their shared covariance once and charging quartic phase interactions. The corrected universal half-allocation proposal reports optimal_inaccurate and gap -2.4056995211233407. The ordering-chart proposal reports 24 floating-point optimal statuses, with negative gaps on nine charts and positive gaps on fifteen. These are source-reported preliminary attempts at arbitrary-amplitude shared-mode gluing, not exact scientific certificates.
quoted_fields.failure: Active-turn preliminary floating-point proposals only. The universal half-allocation solve is optimal_inaccurate with a negative gap; ordering charts include negative gaps. Neither is an exact certificate of infeasibility, a general impossibility result, a full-face proof or a counterexample to the prior restricted gluing theorems. Positive chart gaps are also not exact all-chart certificates. Independent overlapping amplitudes, unrestricted resonance networks and global quasiconvexity of the original 28D face remain unresolved. The arbitrary-amplitude triad, fixed-relative-amplitude overlapping block, their distinct separated-block conditions, earlier exclusions and immutable versions remain intact. No independent scientific audit, new novelty claim, practical advantage or physical interpretation is established.
